title: Mamba Flow Matching Neural Processes: Linear-Time Inference for Irregularly Observed Spatial Fields
abstract: arXiv:2611.26355v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Interpolating a spatial field, such as daily maximum temperature, from sparse, irregularly located observations recurs across the environmental and health sciences. Standard Gaussian-process kriging refits hyperparameters and solves an $O(N^3)$ system for every new field. When many related fields are observed, such as daily maps from one sensor network, neural processes (NPs) instead learn the interpolation map from past fields and predict a new field in one forward pass. Joint-predictive variants, which sample whole fields rather than independent per-location values, typically use self-attention over context and query points, costing $O(K^2)$ in the combined point count $K$ and limiting practical use to a few thousand points. State-space models offer a linear-time alternative, but a direct state-space adaptation compresses the context into one hidden state before reading queries, reducing what the decoder sees. translated_title: Mamba流匹配神经过程：面向不规则观测空间场的线性时间推断
translated_abstract: 从稀疏且位置不规则分布的观测中对空间场（例如每日最高温度）进行插值，在环境科学与健康科学领域是一个反复出现的问题。标准的高斯过程克里金法需要对每个新场重新拟合超参数，并求解复杂度为 O(N³) 的线性方程组。当观测到许多相关的场时，例如来自同一传感器网络的每日地图，神经过程（NPs）则改为从过去的场中学习插值映射，并通过一次前向传播预测新的场。联合预测型变体（即对整个场进行采样，而非在每个位置独立取值）通常在上下文点与查询点上使用自注意力机制，其计算开销在合并点数 K 上为 O(K²)，从而将实际应用限制在几千个点以内。状态空间模型提供了一种线性时间的替代方案，但直接的状态空间适配方式会在读取查询点之前将上下文压缩为单一隐藏状态，减少了解码器所能利用的信息。我们提出了 MambaFlowNP，一种……
tldr: 该论文提出MambaFlowNP，将流匹配与Mamba状态空间模型引入神经过程，实现对不规则观测空间场的线性时间插值推断，突破了自注意力机制 O(K²) 计算开销对可处理点数的限制。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes MambaFlowNP, which integrates flow matching with Mamba state-space models into neural processes to achieve linear-time inference for irregularly observed spatial fields, overcoming the O(K²) cost of self-attention that limits practical use to a few thousand points.
